notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello CrateTastrophers!

We are happy to release the first major patch for the game which includes:


 Challenge mode - fixed several bugs, added additional buttons to have a more seamless quit and return to start menu options
 Store - added graphical assets to clarify currency, fixed achievement related bugs and other inconsistencies
 General - bug fixes, repaired some assets


With this patch the game runs better and smoother.

We are not done with this update! The next major patch will include new mechanics and brand new game options, so stay tuned.

Have fun everyone and we'll see you in the game!

notes.title: First patch coming this weekend!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The first major update for CrateTastrophe will go live this weekend!

Here is what to expect:


 Bug fixes
 Quality of life improvements (especially the in-game store)
 Various improvements


Exciting times are coming! 

See you all soon!

notes.title: News Update!
notes.content:
Hello again CrateTastrophers!

First we want to thank you all for the interest, the direct feedback and comments and of course for playing the game and the demo!

We have some news items to share:

 Had to our website for a major announcement on a future development for CrateTastrophe
 We have had some good reviews and mentions recently, check them out!
 We want to remind everyone that the tournament is still going strong! Get in for a chance to win a very cool prize


That's it for now, keep shooting at those crates and we'll see you in the game!

notes.title: New blog post and major announcement coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have a 2 pieces of news for you today:


 First we have a new development blog post on our site! have you been following the our blog?
 The second bit of news is to hang tight, for major news will be coming later this week on our website - you will not want to miss it, stay tuned! 


Keep your aim true and your rifle ammo plenty and we'll see you in the game!

notes.title: News update! 新闻更新！
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this CrateTastrophe news update we would like to share with you the following:

 On Saturday we will upload a developer's commentary in-depth analysis of the game! The video will be released in two versions, one with English subtitles and the other with Chinese
 China! The game seems to hit a note with Chinese gamers - so in order to welcome their great interest we will translate as much news as we can to Chinese
 More recommendations for CrateTastrophe! We made it to GamesKeys top Steam games for the month of April! 


That's it for today! Now go and destroy some crates!

大家好！

在此游戏新闻更新中，我们希望与您分享以下内容:

 在周六，我们将上传开发者对该游戏的深入分析评论！该视频将发布两个版本，一个带有英文字幕，另一个带有中文字幕
 中国！该游戏似乎吸引了中国玩家的注意-因此，为了欢迎他们的极大兴趣，我们将尽可能多的新闻翻译成中文
 有关游戏的更多建议！我们做到了 GamesKeys 最佳 Steam 四月份的游戏！


今天就这样！现在去消灭一些箱子！

notes.title: CrateTastrophe News Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

How are you enjoying the demo? With thousands of downloads in just a few days we are humbled by the enthusiasm of players!

Please leave us feedback in the official CrateTastrophe Steam group , message us on Facebook or leave a comment on our website.

Updates to both the demo and the game are coming soon as well an in-depth development commentary video revealing some insights regarding CrateTastrophe's design and development.

See you in the game!

notes.title: CrateTastrophe News Update

 Tournament is live and kicking! Who will be the first to reach that 3000 score?


See you in the game!
